title: CUTE Diffcult
description: Brutal Shinto-inspired difficulty mod. Befriend 9 elemental kitsune for blessings, or face their wrath — they remember every wrong you do. (Type i am casual if you give up.)
body:
# Cute Difficult

*"Cruel Universe Tortures Everyone"*

**Minecraft is too easy.** Zombies are dumb. Creepers are visible from a mile away. Furnaces don't explode. Foxes don't kill you with fireballs for the wrong offering.

**This mod fixes all of that.**

---

## TL;DR

A brutal Shinto-inspired difficulty mod where the only path to power is befriending 9 elemental kitsune spirits. They have opinions. They have grudges. They have **fireballs**.

If it gets too rough, type **`i am casual`** in chat. Nobody will judge you. *The kitsune will. But I won't.*

---

## The three layers

**1. A cruel world.** Hostile mobs are smarter and meaner. Creepers spawn charged and invisible. Furnaces overheat and explode. Chests are half-empty (math, not a bug). Villagers price-gouge. Crafting tables sabotage your recipes 15% of the time. Even your Totem of Undying is now a gamble — right-click for a random buff instead of guaranteed save.

**2. Nine kitsune spirits.** Each tied to an element (fire, water, earth, wind, lightning, forest, ice, spirit, sky). Each with their own kami, their own offering, their own personality. Feed them correctly to earn trust. Pet them. Name them. Watch their kits play beside them.

But — they **remember**. Kill one and every kitsune nearby will mark you forever. No amount of gifts brings back broken trust.

**3. Item quality.** Every sword, tool, and armor rolls into one of 5 tiers when it enters your inventory. A Masterwork iron sword outdamages a Crude diamond one. Hunt for tier, not just material.

---

## The path to Inari's grace

Each kitsune element has its own **Blessing** — a passive status effect you keep when your Spirit in that element reaches 10. Fire Resistance from Kasai, Water Breathing from Mizu, Speed from Kaze, Strength from Kaminari, Regeneration from Mori... all nine can stack.

When **all 9 are active simultaneously**, the **Great Blessing of Inari** ignites. Regeneration II, Saturation, AND universal peace with every kitsune — even those who watched you kill their sisters. The world finally says "okay, you did good."

*But raise a hand against a kitsune and it'll fight back. The Great Blessing grants life, not a license to kill.*

---

## What kitsune do

Even a 1-tail kitsune **changes the world around it** through its element:

- **Kasai** melts ice and snow in a 6-block radius. Immune to fire.
- **Mizu** puts out fires, hydrates farmland. Never drowns.
- **Mori** speeds plant growth by ~50%. Cleanses poison from itself.
- **Kaminari** strikes random hostile mobs with lightning. Immune to lightning.
- **Kori** freezes water into packed ice. Immune to freeze damage.
- **Yurei** teleports periodically. Immune to magic and wither.
- **Tengoku** drives off phantoms, weakens nearby hostiles. Glows in the dark.
- **Daichi** restores stone from cobble. Doesn't suffocate.
- **Kaze** softly pushes entities away. Immune to fall damage.

Higher-tail kitsune get **active attacks**: fireballs, ice beams, lightning, in three flavors (single-target, AOE rings, 14-block piercing beams). A 9-tail Kyuubi is basically a small god.

---

## The friendship arc

- **Feed** the right offering → +Trust, +Spirit
- **Pet** at Trust 30 (right-click empty hand) → +1 Trust per hour
- **Sleep with** at Trust 50 — at night, the fox curls up next to you. *This is the most important feature in the mod.*
- **Name** with a name tag — the name biases its personality forever
- **Watch kits play** — friendly adults have a 30% chance to birth babies

If you kill the mom, the kits sit at her body for 30 seconds and weep blue tear particles. *Don't do that.*

---

## The sky hates you too

Three celestial systems layer on top of everything. **Nine special moons** (Blood, Pumpkin, Harvest, Frost, Wolf, Mirror, Cursed, Blue, Hollow) and **six weather events** (Acid Rain, Thunderstorm, Blizzard, Heatwave, Fog, Meteor Shower) each pair a threat with a reward — and they form named **combos** when they coincide.

And then there's **astrology**: nine celestial bodies on real orbits, forming aspects whose exact angle determines how generous (or hostile) the spirits are to each element. They go retrograde, sit in decans, and occasionally align. Read it all with `/cd sky`. Track it like a science, or offer blind and let the stars punish you. *There's even a hidden rite for those who keep a star journal.*

---

## Enhanced enchantments

Give a kitsune your enchanted gear and it transforms the enchantment into a meme-named, buffed version — **Thor, Son of Odin**, **Nanomachines, son!**, **Sub-Zero**, **Let's dance!**, and 18 more. Blessings stack on one item. (Don't use a book — anvils strip the magic. Bless the gear directly.)

---

## Quick commands

- `/cd info` — see your Spirit and Karma
- `/cd sky` — read the celestial ephemeris
- `/cd mode cruel|peace` — toggle world mode
- `/cd fox info` — inspect the nearest kitsune
- Chat: `i am casual` → Peace mode. `i am ready to suffer` → back to Cruel.

---

## More info

For the full feature list, design philosophy, lore breakdown, all commands, all element passives, and the dev journey — see the **[GitHub repository](https://github.com/Hronosin/cute-difficult)** for the full README, DESIGN.md, and CHANGELOG.md.

This is **v1.1.0-beta**, the Cosmic Update. There will be bugs. Report them and I'll fix them. Or don't, and let the kitsune remember.
